Name: Bitter March
Components: S, M (A Keepsake that Reminds You of What Mattered)
Description:
You channel a spark of memory into your weapon, converting the sheer power of every word uttered and all you've seen in the view of your mind into one forceful blast forward. The next ranged weapon attack you hit with within the duration deals an additional 3d6 lightning damage and generates 4 Dynamo.

You deal one additional lightning damage die for each current Pulsing Field Level, and if at 3rd level those become d8s instead.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the spell's effects trigger for an additional hit for each slot level above 2nd.
